📖 Emma and Her New Pencil Case 🎀

Прочитай вслух 2 раза 👅 · потом ответь — да или нет (нажми на строку — появятся ✓ или ✗)
Emma has got a new pencil case. It is blue. There is a cat on it — Emma likes cats! 🐱
What is there in the pencil case? There is a pencil and a pen. There are two rubbers: one is pink and one is yellow. There is a ruler, too. 📏
There is no sharpener in the pencil case! 😱 Where is it? It is at school. 🏫
Emma takes her pencil case to school every day. «I love my new pencil case!» she says. 💙
YIs Emma's pencil case red?
YIs there a cat on the pencil case?
YAre there three rubbers?
YIs the sharpener at school?

А теперь — вопросики! 🎤 Подумай и нажми:

What colour is Emma's pencil case? — Blue!
How many rubbers are there? — Two!
Where is the sharpener? — At school!
What is there in the pencil case? — A pencil, a pen, two rubbers and a ruler!

📹 Видео: What is there in your pencil case? 🎬

Запиши ОДНО видео: покажи свой новый пенал и расскажи, что в нём есть! Громко и красиво ⭐
📖 Подсказка: правило + образец (сначала попробуй сама!)
there is = один → There is a pencil. · there are = два и больше → There are two rubbers.

Образец:
🗣 I've got a pencil case. It's new! It's red. There is a lion on it — Англоград! 🦁
There is a pencil. There are two rubbers. There is … There are …
А что лежит у тебя? Расскажи про все свои вещи! 🎀
